text.enText: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
text.enTextTransliteration: Yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth
text.bnText: যেদিন মানুষ হবে বিক্ষিপ্ত পতংগের মত
text.bntextLatin: yedina manusa habe biksipta patangera mata

text.enText: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
text.enTextTransliteration: Wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh
text.bnText: এবং পর্বতমালা হবে ধুনিত রঙ্গীন পশমের মত।
text.bntextLatin: ebam parbatamala habe dhunita rangina pasamera mata.

text.enText: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
He will be in a pleasant life.
But as for one whose scales are light,
text.enTextTransliteration: Wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh

text.enText: His refuge will be an abyss.
And what can make you know what that is?
It is a Fire, intensely hot.
